purpose: Teach: 練馬/ニンテンドー/ローリング/ヤフオク/ホモ/シャロン/スタミナ/チャンピオンズ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが練馬区の知人とお会いになるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad met with someone from Nerima today.
lines.style: Soft, warm observation. Voice has a gentle lift at the beginning, then settles into quietness. Thoughtful pause before speaking, like she's reflecting on something she found touching.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ニンテンドーの新ゲーム欲しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want the new Nintendo game.
lines.style: Bright and direct, with open vowels. Slight lean forward in the voice. Earnest and unguarded, the way six-year-olds ask for things they've been thinking about all day.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがローリング・ストーンズの曲を聴かせて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad played some Rolling Stones for me today.
lines.style: Tender, slightly surprised. A small smile in the voice. Speaks slowly, as if turning something precious over in her hands. Quiet wonder at the care of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとヤフオクで模型探したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked for model kits on Yahoo Auctions together.
lines.style: Quick, animated delivery. Pride and excitement in equal measure. Voice brightens on the memory. Small, genuine laugh underneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがホモ・サピエンスの絵本読んで下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad read me a picture book about Homo sapiens.
lines.style: Warm recollection, slightly amused. Speaks with the tenderness of someone watching a child discover something new through a parent's patient explanation. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとシャロン元首相のお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me about former Prime Minister Sharon.
lines.style: Conversational and engaged. Voice carries the specific pride of being included in a grown-up conversation. Matter-of-fact but with unmistakable warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはスタミナがあって頼もしいわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad really does have stamina. He's so reliable.
lines.style: Soft, genuine admiration. Slow pace, as if speaking aloud something she's been noticing. A touch of tenderness—not gushing, but real and present. Slight trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとチャンピオンズリーグ観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to watch the Champions League with Dad.
lines.style: Eager, open-mouthed delivery. Hopeful lilt at the end. Voice carries the warmth of closeness—he's imagining it already. Small and genuine, like he's inviting her into the picture.
